rooms.title: My private rooms
rooms.guest: As a guest you play quick matches. Create an account to have your own rooms and appear in the ranking.
rooms.empty: No open rooms yet. Build one and challenge your friends!

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.empty: The ranking fills up with finished matches between registered accounts.

explain.placement: In each match your final place comes from your cards: whoever ends with the most cards finishes first.
explain.rivals: You gain points for every rival below you and lose points for every rival above you. Beating someone with more points than you is worth more (Elo system).
explain.leave: Leaving counts as a loss: you finish last with 0 cards. In a duel, your rival wins the match and takes your cards.
explain.unranked: Only matches between registered accounts are ranked; games against the machine or with guests do not change the ranking.

goal.title: Goal
goal.text: Win every card by comparing your Pokémon stats.

deal.title: The deal
deal.text: The deck is made of quartet packs (1A, 2A, 3A, 4A…); each quartet is one Pokémon type. Every possible card is dealt and the leftovers stay out of play. You only see the top card of your pile.

first.title: Who starts
first.text: Whoever holds card 1A starts; if nobody has it, 1B, 1C… then 2A. After that, play follows the joining order.

round.title: Each round
round.text: The player on turn picks an attribute of their card and everyone lays down their top card. The highest value wins, takes every card on the table and picks the next attribute.

tie.title: Ties and the pot
tie.text: On a tie the cards stay in the pot and another round is played; whoever wins the next one takes the pot as well.

leave.title: Leaving
leave.text: Leaving a match is final and counts as a loss. In a duel your rival wins with all your cards; with more players your cards are shared out among the rest and the match goes on.

end.title: End of the match
end.text: It ends when someone holds every card or time runs out: whoever has the most cards wins, and equal counts are a draw.

create.title: Set up your table
create.attrIntro: They are each Pokémon’s official base stats. On your turn you pick one and the highest value wins. Fewer attributes make a quicker match; all 6 make it more strategic.

attr.hp: Hit points: how much damage it takes before fainting.
attr.speed: Quickness: decides who acts first in battle.
